newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins dip further on IMF news,seen lower.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins dip further on IMF news,seen lower.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds eased further on Friday after news the International Monetary Fund mission failed to reach agreement with Russia about the next tranche of its loan, dealers said.
The Russian central bank said in a statement on Thursday an IMF team will leave Moscow without reaching a conclusion on whether to give Russia the latest tranche of a three-year $10 billion loan.
The two sides had failed to agree on a series of issues, including budget revenues, it said.
Trading had started at higher levels in Moscow but later London and New York operators stepped in and pushed prices down.
"Prices have been going down the whole day. They eased further after the first signs of the difficulties in the negotiations (between IMF and Russia) and are falling now," one dealer said.

Dealers said a further fall was likely today and over the next week. "New York could sell something else today and generally we see lower levels in the next few days," an ICFI Moscow Partners Bank dealer said.
